cm: A cm is a metric unit of length equal to one hundredth of a meter.
Cm can also mean a radioactive transuranic metallic element.
Cm means the same as centimeter or centimetre or curium.
cmb: CMB is the cooled remnant of the hot big bang that fills the entire universe and can be observed today with an average temperature of about 2.725 kelvin.
CMB means the same as cosmic background radiation or CBR or cosmic microwave background radiation.
cmbr: CMBR is the cooled remnant of the hot big bang that fills the entire universe and can be observed today with an average temperature of about 2.725 kelvin.
CMBR means the same as cosmic background radiation or CBR or cosmic microwave background radiation.
cmv: CMV is any of a group of herpes viruses that enlarge epithelial cells and can cause birth defects.
CMV means the same as cytomegalovirus.
